items.title: File objection (Einspruch) against the fine
items.quote: Die Frist für den Einspruch beträgt zwei Wochen ab Zustellung; einzulegen ist er schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Kreisverwaltung Musterweiler – Bußgeldstelle.
items.computation: The letter was formally served (Postzustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO), so the statutory deemed-delivery fiction for ordinary post does not apply; the start date is the service date noted on the returned delivery envelope: 'zugestellt am 17.04.20' (17.04.2025, consistent with the document date 14.04.2025 and the '25' handwritten below). Under § 67 Abs. 1 OWiG the objection period is two weeks from service. Counting under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB: the day of service (17.04.2025) is not counted, so the period starts 18.04.2025; two weeks later (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) falls on Thursday 01.05.2025, which is the nationwide public holiday Erster Mai. Under § 43 StPO (via § 46 Abs. 1 OWiG) the deadline moves to the next business day, Friday 02.05.2025.

items.title: Pay the total fine amount (Geldbuße, Gebühr, Auslagen)
items.quote: Fälligkeit des Gesamtbetrags: zwei Wochen nach Eintritt der Rechtskraft.
items.computation: Rechtskraft (finality) sets in once the Einspruch period lapses without an objection being filed, i.e. the day after the objection deadline computed above: 03.05.2025 (a Saturday). Payment is due two weeks after that. Counting under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, the day of the triggering event (03.05.2025) is not counted, so the period starts 04.05.2025; two weeks later (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) falls on Saturday 17.05.2025. Under § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG the deadline moves to the next business day, Monday 19.05.2025. This date only applies if no Einspruch is filed by 02.05.2025; filing an objection in time suspends the fine's finality and this payment obligation.

warnings: The service date on the scanned delivery envelope reads '17.04.20', cut off at the edge of the page; it was read as 17.04.2025 based on the surrounding dates and the handwritten '25' below it — confirm this against the original envelope, since the entire Einspruch deadline (and the payment deadline that follows it) is calculated from that date.
The payment deadline of 19.05.2025 only applies if no Einspruch is filed by 02.05.2025; an objection filed within that time suspends both the fine's finality and the payment obligation.
